issues.description: Interface name mismatch: The problem statement (UML and text) requires an interface named 'Rideable' with an abstract method messageOnRide(). The solution repository does not provide a functional 'Rideable' interface — Rideable.java is effectively empty — and instead defines an interface named 'Mountable' which is used by Pig and Seal (they implement Mountable and provide messageOnRide()). This naming divergence between 'Rideable' (expected by the exercise specification and template examples) and 'Mountable' (used in the solution) will confuse students and can break automated checks or tests that expect the name 'Rideable'.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single, consistent interface name that matches the problem statement and UML: rename the solution's 'Mountable' interface to 'Rideable' (or add a proper 'Rideable' interface) and update all classes to implement 'Rideable'. Remove or populate the empty Rideable.java in the solution repository so the interface exists with the correct signature: public interface Rideable { String messageOnRide(); }. Keep Milkable as-is.
